title: Auto Finance Portfolio Analytics
summary: Help auto lending teams spot delinquency and vintage losses early, work collections by roll risk, and catch dealer first-payment defaults, all on one governed semantic layer.

images.alt: Portfolio overview: funded contracts, open balance, collections queue size, October 2026 KPIs including 30+ DPD and annualized charge-offs, and trend charts
Credit and portfolio risk: cumulative charge-offs by vintage, a used 84-month segment check, a roll-rate matrix, and origination mix
Collections work queue: early-delinquency accounts ranked by a transparent roll-risk score, with balance, status history, and loan details
Account view: roll-risk score parts, payment history, an AI_COMPLETE call summary, and a form to assign a collector or record a promise to pay
Dealer drill-down: first-payment defaults by funded month jumping in 2026, a Flag for review action, and an AI_COMPLETE narrative
Ask the portfolio: Cortex Analyst via a Cortex Agent answers which dealers have the highest first-payment default rate, using a verified query
Dealer performance: watchlist of first-payment defaults and year-over-year decline-rate rises across 1,500 dealers

author: Oz Oral
